Short title and commencement

ACT VII OF 2019
ACT VII OF 2019
LIMITATION (BALOCHISTAN AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2019
An Act further to amend the Limitation Act, 1908
(Act IX of 1908) in its application to the province
of Balochistan
[Gazette of Balochistan Extraordinary,
26th August, 2019]
No.
PAB/Legis; V (12)/2019, dated 26.8.2019.---The Limitation (Balochistan Amendment) Bill 2019 Bill No. 12 of 2019
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 10th August,
2019 and assented to by the Governor Balochistan, on 19th August, 2019 is
hereby published as an Act of the Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
WHEREAS,
it is expedient further to amend the Limitation Act, 1908 (Act IX of 1908), in
its application to the province of Balochistan, in the manner hereinafter
appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Limitation (Balochistan Amendment) Act, 2019.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of First Schedule, Act IX of 1908
